text:
support_lead: Opening war room — multiple customers reporting 502/504 spikes and high p95 timeouts to hosted inference in us-west since ~09:03 UTC. Also seeing a billing duplicate-charge alert. @sre_oncall @infra_engineer please triage.

sre_oncall: Looking at SLO dashboards — 502s spiked at 09:02. Gateway CPU at ~95%, upstream backends returning 502/504 and some 429s. Correlating with increased auth latency to token service.

infra_engineer: I see a sudden jump in KV-cache misses + authz latency. Billing auth service showing a burst of 500s starting 08:58. Clients start retrying which amplifies gateway load.

customer_success: Flags: a handful of enterprise customers reported 504s and duplicate billing emails. They're asking for an ETA.

billing_lead: We deployed a small change to billing-token-validate at 08:58 (canary). Rolling that change back now while we investigate.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for billing-token-service: v1.3.7 -> v1.3.6 (run_id=dpl-8342).

support_lead: Mitigation plan — 1) rollback billing change (in progress), 2) enable gateway circuit-breaker and reduce per-client burst, 3) scale up dedicated pool by 10% temporarily. Keep comms concise.

sre_oncall: Executed: circuit-breaker enabled on gateway, per-client connection cap lowered, added capacity to runtime pool. Observability: start watch on 5xx rate and auth latency.

infra_engineer: Repro steps to validate locally: run the below and look for upstream 504s

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -H "X-Client-Req-Id: repro-123" \n  -d '{"model":"gptx-13b","input":"hello"}' \n  --max-time 10
```

Sample gateway log snippet (filtered):
```
[09:02:11] gw-01 ERROR upstream_timeout id=repro-123 upstream=token-validate svc=billing-token-service error="504 Gateway Timeout"
[09:02:12] gw-01 WARN retry_amplify client_id=acct-987 retries=4 queue_len=12
[09:02:14] auth-01 ERROR token-validate 500 "null pointer" request_id=req-5512
```

sre_oncall: Early results — 5xx rate down ~70% after rollback + circuit-breaker. p95 latency improved from ~1200ms -> ~380ms for affected routes. Billing duplicate-alerts still trickling in but should stop as rollback completes.

billing_lead: Rollback finished and verified. Opening follow-up postmortem. Action items I'm capturing now: 
- Add stricter canary gating for billing-token-service (rate and errors)
- Add per-instance rate-limits and queue backpressure to prevent retry storms
- Improve integration tests for token validation edge cases
- Add an alert for authz 5xx > 1/min per service to pager

support_lead: I'll draft a customer-facing update and push to affected customers with ETA 30m. Also will include suggested customer mitigation (exponential backoff).

infra_engineer: For RCA deep dive: I'll pull heap/GC and latency traces for token-validate instances around 08:50-09:10 and compare to deploy timeline.

sre_oncall: Follow-ups for ops: tune circuit-breaker thresholds, validate autoscaler reaction to short spikes, add synthetic test hitting token path every 1m for canary coverage.

billing_lead: I'll own the retro. tagging owners: @infra_engineer (RCA), @sre_oncall (operational mitigations), @billing_lead (code fixes), @support_lead (customer comms).

support_lead: Thanks team. Closing war room in ~45m unless we see regressions. I'll create the postmortem doc and link to this thread. :thumbsup:
